title: Circulaire AMMC n° 03/19 du 20 février 2019 relative aux opérations et informations financières (rapport ESG, articles 2.58 and 2.59)
citation: Circulaire de l'Autorité marocaine du marché des capitaux n° 03/19 of 20 February 2019, homologated by arrêté of the finance minister n° 1704.19 of 30 May 2019 (BO 6784 bis); amended by circulaire n° 02/20 of 22 December 2020 (arrêté 3730.21 of 8 December 2021)
evidence: Page https://www.ammc.ma/fr/reglementations/circulaires (opened 2026-11-02) lists "Circulaire de l'Autorité marocaine du marché des capitaux n° 03/19 relative aux opérations et informations financières" (PDF titled BO_6784-bis_fr, 20.8 MB, scan with no text layer) and "Circulaire de l'AMMC n°02/20 du 22 décembre 2020 complétant et modifiant la circulaire n°03/19 du 20 février 2019"; the BO text of arrêté 3730.21 (8 December 2021, file Circulaire de l'AMMC 02-20 du 22 Décembre 2020_0.pdf, Arabic) approves 02/20 as an amendment of 03/19 and cites arrêté 1704.19 of 30 May 2019 for 03/19. No commencement clause was readable.
notes: No official page opened states a first in-force date, so in_force is null; the circular is dated 20 February 2019 and was homologated on 30 May 2019 (the date in the arrêté number cited in the 02/20 gazette text). The AMMC PDF is a scan; the register row's earlier statement that article 2.58 requires an ESG report in the annual financial report was not re-read from the scan. Whether circulaire 02/20 touches the ESG chapter was not read (its French text was not on the page opened; the file is the Arabic BO page of the approving arrêté). No 2024 or 2025 amendment appears on the AMMC circulaires page. The existing register row pointed at a casablanca-bourse.com media copy; it now points at the AMMC page. Link only: row MA-AMMC-ADOPTED is permission requested (the AMMC mentions légales prohibit reproduction and modification; whether Loi 2-00 art. 8 covers a circulaire as a texte administratif is open). Government English: none looked for beyond the AMMC site, whose /en pages carry the interface only.
status_note: Permission requested from AMMC, not sent. Not stored.

title: Loi-cadre n° 99-12 portant charte nationale de l'environnement et du développement durable

B.O n° 6240 du 18 joumada I 1435 ( 20 mars 2014)." The page gives the BO publication date; no page opened states an entry-into-force date.
